objective: BC-4 program: pre-register and implement a live volume-semantics probe (Test 1 semantic identity vs independently-counted ticks, Test 2 artifact binding across the frozen corpus's full range), score the live pair, register the finding honestly (TICK_VOLUME_APPROXIMATE, not CONFIRMED -- the frozen prereg forbids rounding a small directional gap up to an exact match), then wire the BC-4a enforcement half: turn the previously-dead SCHEMA_PATH into a real fail-closed jsonschema validation, add is_synthetic to the schema, and write SEED-OHLCV-19 (the proxy-branch test the closure report names as never written).
change_class_rationale: Evidence probe + schema-enforcement change for OHLCV BC-4 on the admitted dataset's producer family, same class as the BC-2 program. Schema validation is additive/behavior-preserving (verified before wiring: the one existing record validates cleanly as-is). No admission-gate behavior change beyond turning a presence-only check into a real one that was already declared required. No CAD migration.
verdict_invariance: The prereg's frozen scoring rules (section 4/5 verdict tables) were never touched after they were written. All three bugs found during capture were in the CAPTURE layer (a clock-basis mismatch feeding age comparisons, a missing positional argument to copy_rates_range, and unaligned M15-lattice sample targets) -- each was root-caused with an isolated read-only diagnostic probe before any fix, and each was verified not to change the frozen thresholds or verdict vocabulary. TICK_VOLUME_APPROXIMATE is not a downgrade invented after the fact -- it is section 4 rule 3 of the prereg, written before any live bar was scored.

unknowns.question: Whether Test 1 would ever reach TICK_VOLUME_CONFIRMED (exact match) given more data, or whether the ~0.6% tick-vs-bar-aggregation gap is a structural property of how the terminal computes tick_volume vs COPY_TICKS_ALL.
unknowns.resolution: Non-blocking. TICK_VOLUME_APPROXIMATE is a valid, real, and useful terminal state under the frozen interpretation table -- it does not need to resolve to CONFIRMED to be reported. BC-4 stays a blocker either way pending further evidence.
unknowns.followup: A larger Test 1 sample (more fresh bars over multiple sessions) could clarify whether the gap is a fixed small bias or something that occasionally reaches exact match; not pursued this turn -- would need a new pre-registered threshold, not a retroactive one.

unknowns.question: Why 3 of 20 Test 2 samples had no re-fetchable bar (2024-06-29T11:00, 2024-09-14T07:00, 2024-11-30T03:00).
unknowns.resolution: Not investigated -- consistent with the same session/holiday-gap class already documented in F-098, and Test 2's verdict rule only requires the USABLE sample to clear its threshold (17/17 did, at 100%), so an unresolved gap does not by itself contradict BOUND.
unknowns.followup: None planned; would only matter if artifact_binding needed to move off BOUND.
